# Revenium Go SDK

> Go SDK for automatic AI usage metering, cost tracking, and analytics across 13 providers.

Revenium wraps your existing AI provider clients (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) and sends metering data asynchronously to the Revenium platform, so metering never slows a call down. Calls reach the provider as you wrote them, except that a call breaching a cost-control block is refused before it is sent and a Claude call on Bedrock is converted to Bedrock's request format (see llms-full.txt). Each provider is its own Go module -- install only what you need.

- License: MIT
- Minimum Go: Go 1.21 to 1.25 by module (table below)
- Version: v1.x (stable, semver)

## Docs

- [Full LLM Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/main/llms-full.txt): Complete SDK reference optimized for LLM consumption
- [README](https://github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/blob/main/README.md): Full documentation with examples
- [Go Reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk): Godoc for all modules
- [Changelog](https://github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history
- [Revenium Docs](https://docs.revenium.io): Platform documentation

## Minimum Go version

Each module declares its own minimum Go version in its `go.mod`, set by the module and the dependencies it pulls in. On an older Go, `go get` either fails with `requires go >= ...` or, when `GOTOOLCHAIN` allows downloads, fetches a newer Go and raises the `go` line in your `go.mod`. Check the row of every module you install; `core` comes in with every provider.

| Module | Minimum Go |
|---|---|
| `core` | 1.21 |
| `fal` | 1.21 |
| `grok` | 1.21 |
| `groq` | 1.21 |
| `runway` | 1.21 |
| `webhooks` | 1.21 |
| `litellm` | 1.22 |
| `ollama` | 1.22 |
| `anthropic` | 1.24 |
| `google` | 1.24 |
| `openai` | 1.25 |
| `perplexity` | 1.25 |

## Modules

- [core](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/core): Shared utilities, errors, logging, config, context helpers
- [core/metering](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/core/metering): Metering client and tool event builder
- [core/jobs](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/core/jobs): Job outcome tracking and amendment
- [core/enforcement](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/core/enforcement): Cost control enforcement engine
- [core/resilience](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/core/resilience): Circuit breaker, retry with jitter, error classification
- [openai](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/openai): OpenAI and Azure OpenAI middleware
- [anthropic](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/anthropic): Anthropic and Anthropic Bedrock middleware
- [google](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/google): Google GenAI and Vertex AI middleware
- [perplexity](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/perplexity): Perplexity middleware
- [litellm](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/litellm): LiteLLM proxy middleware
- [fal](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/fal): fal.ai middleware (image, video, audio, chat)
- [runway](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/runway): Runway middleware
- [ollama](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/ollama): Ollama middleware
- [groq](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/groq): Groq middleware
- [grok](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/revenium/revenium-go-sdk/grok): Grok (xAI) middleware
